say:3:1222521001:1.text: What were those creatures just now?
say:3:1222521001:1.source_cn: 我说，刚才的对手都是什么东西？

say:4:1222521002:1.text: As I was slashing through them, it felt like slashing through a vortex...

say:7:1222521004:1.source_cn: 没错！而且要击败恶魔，还需要持剑者的协助。

say:8:1222521005:1.text: You know who I'm talking about, right? Our wandering captain and Rustport's newest hero, Sinbad!

say:14:1222521011:1.text: Alright, I remember what you did for Brineville. Even if you asked me to jump off a bridge, I'd do it without question.

say:15:1222521012:1.source_cn: 但是，“持剑者”……你们是说我之前拿到的罗盘？罗盘能做...

say:16:1222521013:1.text: Let's not talk about fighting right now. The more important thing is to <style="highlight">find him first</style>.

say:17:1222521014:1.text: When he first showed up to the island, he went straight to the Land of Riches and laid waste to the place. He even bit a huge hole out of the cave wall and then escaped into the water.

say:18:1222521015:1.text: This is easy then. Battles aren't my forte, but I can definitely find someone.
say:18:1222521015:1.source_cn: 这好办，我打架不行，但是找人在行。

say:19:1222521016:1.text: If I think about the location of the Hypogean, the compass will do the rest.
say:19:1222521016:1.source_cn: 只要想着让罗盘引领我去恶魔的所在地，它或许会做出提示……

say:21:1222521017:1.text: Look! The needle on the compass is moving!
say:21:1222521017:1.source_cn: 看呐，罗盘的指针旋转起来了！
